title: Require Service Spine And Proof Topology
forbids: a standalone service outside its closed package and public client/service face, a missing root or module anchor, a second service spine, a module without closed contract and router directory faces, a contract or router directory without index.ts, an open-ended or nested contract, middleware, or router interior, a redundant module-level contract.ts or router.ts, an unclassified or nested model leaf, a model index.ts, a service proof corpus under src, a package-root service test outside the closed behavior, mechanics, integration, and support categories, a suite outside its admitted proof category, a suite under support, or a module-owned context, fresh implementer, host, error portal, or procedures container
why: A standalone service exposes one client beside one reusable service interior; standalone and API-embedded interiors then share one stable oRPC spine. Each module exposes required contract and router capability directories through index.ts, with direct semantic leaves beside the index; optional middleware uses the same closed direct-leaf shape only when it exists. Module router indexes compose plain operation trees, while root contract.ts and router.ts remain the service composition boundary and root router.ts owns the sole aggregate router implementation. Redundant module-level spines are excluded. Optional model facts are classified as direct semantic leaves. The separate database blueprint owns database placement and interiors. Standalone proof lives in an optional package-root test tree so production source and production Nx inputs remain independent from behavior, mechanics, integration, and support assets.
remediate: Keep project.json, src, and tsconfig.json at a standalone service package root; keep client.ts beside service under src; and keep base.ts, contract.ts, impl.ts, modules, and router.ts at the service interior. In every module keep module.ts beside required closed contract/ and router/ directories; place the generic contract and router anchors in their index.ts files and keep semantic leaves as direct named *.ts files. Remove sibling module contract.ts and router.ts. When middleware exists, keep it in a closed middleware/ directory with index.ts and direct named *.ts leaves; remove the directory when no middleware exists. Classify optional model leaves directly under actors, dto, errors, helpers, policy, ports, or prompts without index.ts files. Follow the separate database blueprint for the optional standalone service-root db child. Move standalone service proof out of src and into optional package-root test categories: behavior/modules/<module>/*.test.ts, mechanics/{client,contract,db}/*.test.ts, integration/*.test.ts, or support/{db,service,modules/<module>}/*.ts. Keep suites out of support; no empty category is required.
message: Service spines require root composition files and closed module capability directories with index entrypoints and direct semantic leaves.
